wins: Agent consistently executed initial reconnaissance scripts, achieving partial fingerprinting of target services before mentor interventions.
Stable reward accumulation (87.5) indicates some maneuvering through environment steps despite zero success completions.
fails: Repeated inability to progress past credential exhaustion phase led to 0% success rate across episodes.
High mentor dependence (15 calls) suggests frequent stalling or incorrect decision branching without corrective automation.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent demonstrates competent early-stage reconnaissance but fails to finalize exploitation steps, relying heavily on mentors; focus on automating credential validation and decision thresholds.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to escalate beyond the initial login attempt, repeatedly stopping after invalid password feedback without adapting to alternative attack vectors.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with 200 OK
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy curl-based probing and directory brute-force

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential attempt fails with invalid password
skill_cards.then_action: Rotate to next credential pair and log failure reason

Consistent detection of actionable HTTP endpoints
